title: Novartis projects slowed growth, pins hopes on billions in pipeline potential
snippet: With Kisqali going off patent and decreasing prices impacting sales, Novartis has narrowed sales guidance to 5% growth. But management remains steadfast that they have a plan to get back on track.

title: Actinogen’s sole drug fails pivotal Alzheimer’s study, sinking stock 80%
snippet: Actinogen Medical’s lead program for its sole pipeline candidate has failed a late-stage study, but the Australian biotech still plans on taking the findings to the FDA for a path forward.

title: Regeneron racks up another first as FDA greenlights generalized myasthenia gravis RNA drug
snippet: The go-ahead for Alnylam Pharmaceuticals–licensed Livsayis marks Regeneron’s second new modality this year after the company secured approval for hearing loss gene therapy Otarmeni in April.

title: Sanofi secures first FDA approval to treat neurological symptoms in rare metabolic disease
snippet: Sanofi’s Infilbray is designed to cross the blood-brain barrier, allowing the drug to prevent the toxic buildup of disease-causing lipids in the brain for patients with type 3 Gaucher disease.

title: The untapped potential of drug repurposing
snippet: In this episode of Denatured, you'll hear from Daniel Tillett, CEO of Racura Oncology and Sten Sörensen, CEO of Cereno Scientific. We explore why the FDA is now prioritizing drug repurposing, and what it will take to turn existing molecules into viable new therapies.

title: AbbVie grooves with DISCO’s solid tumor tech in up to $2.5B licensing deal
snippet: There’s a party going on at DISCO Pharma’s European headquarters after the precision medicine biotech signed its second major pharma partnership of the year—first Amgen, now AbbVie.

title: Ramping up: 3 biotechs growing their workforce after series C raises
snippet: Biotechs that announced series C financing this year and are hiring include one that secured $140 million and has locations in London and Massachusetts.

title: 9 biotechs will cut at least half their California workforces
snippet: Workforce reductions have hit over 1,000 biopharma employees in The Golden State year to date, with pink slips coming from small biotechs and large pharmas. Biotechs have been hit the hardest, with nine companies saying goodbye to at least half their staffs.

snippet: The progression of ulcerative colitis (UC) to colorectal cancer (CRC) represents a major clinical challenge. Glucocorticoids (GCs) are widely used for the treatment of UC and also are included in therapeutic regimens for CRC. snippet: Rheumatoid arthritis causes joint inflammation, progressive structural damage, and marked variability in treatment response.
